annotations.title: Wai prompt library: 30,000+ ready questions and the Wai tool that answers each

description: Search Wai's library of more than 30,000 ready questions - engineering (electrical, mechanical, architectural), energy and grid (solar, wind, BESS, hydro, hydrogen, data centers), finance, legal (EU law, Yargıtay), HR, country and sector questions for 80 countries, travel and trails, reports and LinkedIn posts, open data - by words, category, country (ISO code) or sector. Each result says which Wai tool answers it (wai_draw_site, wai_calculate, wai_official_data, wai_trails, WaiMAP ...) and how to call it. Use it when the user asks what Wai can do, wants ideas or examples for a field or a country, or when you are not sure which Wai tool fits a request. Answer with the returned numbers, not an estimate made before the call.
